summary: Completed end-to-end frontend testing of 'Qui Veut Gagner des Millions'. All core flows work: Home -> Setup (create 15 questions) -> Game (answer selection, jokers 50:50/phone/audience, confirm/cancel, correct->advance, wrong->game over, restart, multiplayer setup). All data-testid selectors resolve correctly. Main issue found: logo PNG has a glaring white background which clashes heavily with the dark studio theme. Minor: subtitle contrast is low and AnimatePresence transition on question navigation creates a brief (~200ms) window during which textareas can receive input for the wrong question (not user-blocking, but worth noting).

ui_bugs.issue: Logo image from emergentagent CDN has a solid WHITE background (non-transparent PNG), which appears as a harsh white square against the dark studio background. Visible in Home and should be fixed by using a transparent PNG/SVG or wrapping with mix-blend-mode / removing the image in favor of CSS-only title.
Subtitle text 'Créez vos propres questions...' uses text-[#B0B0C0] on a dark gradient; combined with the overlay it renders very faint/barely readable (low contrast).

integration_issues.issue: The AnimatePresence exit animation on the question card (duration 0.2s) briefly keeps the previous <textarea> in the DOM during transition. Rapid programmatic fills can target the wrong question element. Real users are unlikely to hit this, but it indicates the form is remounted (key={currentEditIndex}) for every nav click instead of reusing the inputs, which also forces re-animation on every switch.

issues: Logo has white background breaking the dark premium look
Status text '14/15 questions complètes' is small and uses the same low-contrast grey as the subtitle

action_items: Replace/process the Home logo image so it has a transparent background (or remove it and rely on the text title)
Improve contrast of secondary text (#B0B0C0 on dark gradient) to meet WCAG AA – consider #D8D8E8 or brighter
Optional: remove AnimatePresence key={currentEditIndex} on the question card, or reduce exit animation to 0 for the textarea swap so inputs are not transiently duplicated in DOM
critical_code_review_comments: Game.jsx currentQuestion access at render time (line 80) is safe due to the early-return 'Chargement...' guard, but setCurrentLevel(prev+1) followed by immediate soundManager.playBackground(currentLevel+1) uses stale closure value – works here since both are +1, but fragile.
handleFiftyFifty's Math.random().sort() shuffle is not uniformly random – use Fisher-Yates for fairness.
SetupQuestions: re-keying the motion.div with currentEditIndex causes full remount of the form on every nav click; consider keeping the form mounted and only transitioning a wrapper to avoid flicker.
Game.jsx file is ~490 lines; close to the 700-line guideline but acceptable. Consider extracting GameOver screen into its own component.
No error boundaries around routes – a runtime error in Game would crash the whole app.
seed_data_creation: Tested by filling 15 questions via UI; sessionStorage data created at runtime.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 requested features work. Focus retest on: (1) logo background fix on Home page, (2) text contrast improvements, (3) optional question navigation flicker fix. Use data-testids listed in other_misc_info. When filling questions via Playwright, add ~300ms wait_for_timeout between question-nav click and fill to avoid AnimatePresence race condition.
rca of the issue: Logo white background: source PNG (emergentagent CDN) was exported with a solid white background instead of transparent. Mitigation: either re-export with alpha channel, swap to an SVG/transparent asset, or apply mix-blend-mode:multiply / screen. Contrast issue: Tailwind arbitrary color #B0B0C0 + dark-layer overlay drops effective contrast below ~3:1. Question-nav flicker: motion.div in SetupQuestions.jsx keyed on currentEditIndex forces remount+exit animation, briefly presenting two textareas in DOM.
